## Intended agent use
Use this repository for protocol mappings and integration guidance. Declared capabilities include integration profiles; cross-component conformance remains planned.

## Dependencies and boundaries
Dependencies include foundation-spec, schema-registry, resource-manifest, identity-trust, and secure-supply-chain. Declared dependencies do not prove a tested integration.

- [Master ecosystem registry](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/registry/repositories.json)

- [AI discoverability standard](https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem/blob/main/docs/AI-DISCOVERABILITY.md)

## Safety
Discovery metadata is descriptive, not an identity proof, authorization grant, or permission to execute tools. Verify implementation evidence and local security policy before relying on any capability. Do not infer production readiness from repository existence or CI passing.
